roots.origin: 拉丁语 satis（够了、足量），形容词 satur（吃饱的）、动词 satiare（使之够）同支；satisfacere = satis + facere（做到够），承义的是 satis。satira（杂盘、杂咏）是另一支，satire 不属本族
roots.core_concept: enough, and not a drop past it / 到够为止，不再多添
roots.core_image: 往碗里一勺勺加，加到与碗口齐平就停手，再加就溢出去
roots.english_definition: enough, sated, full to the point of no more

roots.origin: 拉丁语 solus（单独的、唯一的），派生 solitarius（独处的）、solare（使之孤零），desolare = de-（彻底）+ solare。拉丁语另有 sol（太阳），与本根不同源，solar 属太阳那一支，勿混；库中 solvere（解开）、solidus（结实的）也各是别的来路，与 solus 无关
roots.core_concept: one thing standing with nothing else beside it / 只此一个，旁边再没有别的
roots.core_image: 一张长桌只坐着一个人，其余椅子全空着，屋里没有第二个声音

concepts.concept: enough, and not a drop past it
concepts.core_image: 往碗里一勺勺加，加到与碗口齐平就停手，再加就溢出去

concepts.concept: one thing standing with nothing else beside it
concepts.core_image: 一张长桌只坐着一个人，其余椅子全空着，屋里没有第二个声音

words.root_logic: satis（够）+ fy（facere 做）→ 做到够为止，对方那一头才算填平
words.origin: 拉丁语 satisfacere（做到够）：satis（够）+ facere（做），经古法语 satisfier 入英语
words.native_definition: to give someone enough of what they want or need
words.core_concept: topping a want up until it is level – 把对方的需求添到齐平那条线
words.core_image: 客人碗里的汤一勺勺添到齐口，他放下勺子说不用再加了
examples: Nothing I did could satisfy my strict boss.
This design satisfies all the safety rules.
semantic_expansions: 满足/使满意：需求那一头被添到齐口，人就不再往上要了
符合：条件先设了一条线，量添到那条线上就算过
collocations: satisfy a condition/requirement —— 符合某项条件，宾语是标准而不是人
be satisfied with sth —— 对某事觉得够了，过去分词作形容词

words.root_logic: satis（够）+ fact（facere 做）+ -ion → 做到够之后落下来的那口气
words.origin: 拉丁语 satisfactio（做到够这件事）← satisfacere，经古法语入英语
words.native_definition: the good feeling that comes from getting enough of what one wanted
words.core_concept: the settled feeling that enough has been reached – 到够了之后落定的那口气
words.core_image: 他把最后一颗螺丝拧紧，退开两步看了一会儿，长长吐出一口气
examples: She smiled with quiet satisfaction at the result.
The repair gave him little satisfaction.
semantic_expansions: 满意/满足感：添到齐口之后心里落定的那一下
称心的事：把带来那口气的具体事物也叫这个名
collocations: to sb's satisfaction —— 做到让某人认可的程度，多用于结果验收
with satisfaction —— 带着那口气做某个动作，常修饰 smile 或 nod

words.root_logic: satis（够）+ fact（做）+ -ory → 做到了够这条线，刚好过关
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 satisfactorius ← satisfacere（做到够）
words.native_definition: good enough for the purpose, though not more than that
words.core_concept: just over the line of enough and no higher – 刚过够这条线，再往上没有了
words.core_image: 验收单上打了勾，写着可以交付，没有一句夸奖的话
examples: Her work was satisfactory but not outstanding.
We need a satisfactory answer before Friday.
semantic_expansions: 合格的：量正好落在那条线上，够了就放行
尚可的：够是够了但并不多出来，所以这话听着不算夸奖，只是不挑毛病
令人满意的：正式场合里说对方那一头已被填平

words.root_logic: satur（吃饱的）+ -ate → 灌到再也吃不进去
words.origin: 拉丁语 saturare（灌到饱）← satur（吃饱的），与 satis（够）同支
words.native_definition: to fill something completely so that no more can be taken in
words.core_concept: filled to the point where no more goes in – 灌到再也进不去一点
words.core_image: 毛巾按进水里，提起来水直往下滴，再泡也吸不进一点
examples: Heavy rain saturated the soil overnight.
Ads have saturated the local market.
semantic_expansions: 浸透：液体把纤维之间的空隙全占了
使饱和：加进去的量到了上限，多加也不再溶
充满：市场或空气被占到没有余地，也借这个词

words.root_logic: solus（单独）→ 只此一个，数下来就它一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 solus（单独的、唯一的），经古法语 sol 入英语；同形的 sole（鞋底、鳎鱼）来自拉丁语 solea（鞋底），与本词不同源
words.native_definition: being the only one of its kind in a situation
words.core_concept: the only one left when the rest are gone – 数下来只此一个，旁边是空的
words.core_image: 名单上原有二十个名字，划到最后只剩一行没被划掉
examples: He was the sole survivor of the crash.
She has sole responsibility for the accounts.
semantic_expansions: 唯一的/仅有的：清点之后只剩这一个
单独的：权利或责任只落在一方身上，没有第二方分担
collocations: sole responsibility/purpose/survivor —— 唯一的，直接放在名词前，一般不作表语
the sole + n + of sth —— 某个范围里仅有的那一个

words.root_logic: solus（单独）→ 一个人唱或奏，别人都停下
words.origin: 意大利语 solo（单独的）← 拉丁语 solus，先用作乐谱标记，后进英语
words.native_definition: a piece of music performed by one person alone
words.core_concept: one performer left sounding while the rest stop – 全体停下，只剩一个人在响
words.core_image: 乐队全体收声，只有一把小提琴还在拉，灯只打在她身上
examples: She played a long violin solo tonight.
He made his first solo flight last week.
semantic_expansions: 独奏/独唱：乐队里只剩一个人在发声
单独的：飞行或攀登只有一人上，也借这个词

words.root_logic: de-（彻底）+ sol（solus 单独）+ -ate → 被弄成孤零零的一片，人都不在了
words.origin: 拉丁语 desolatus ← desolare：de-（彻底）+ solare（使之孤零）← solus（单独的）
words.native_definition: empty of people and comfort, so that it feels bleak
words.core_concept: made utterly alone until nothing warm is left – 被弄到彻底剩下自己，一点热气都没有
words.core_image: 风刮过一片空地，几堵断墙立着，路上连一个脚印都没有
examples: They crossed a desolate stretch of moorland.
The empty house looked desolate in winter.
semantic_expansions: 荒凉的/无人的：地方被弄空，剩下的只有它自己
凄凉的：同一种空落感移到心上，说人的处境

words.root_logic: solus（单独）+ -arius（属于…的）→ 独自一个进行，或整片里只有这一个
words.origin: 拉丁语 solitarius（独处的）← solus（单独的）
words.native_definition: done alone, or being the only one there
words.core_concept: going about it with no one else along – 从头到尾只有一个，旁边没有伴
words.core_image: 整片沙滩上一串脚印，从这头走到那头，没有第二串与它并行
examples: He took a solitary walk along the shore.
A solitary lamp burned in the hallway.
semantic_expansions: 独自的：动作自始至终只有一个人在做
仅有的：整片范围里只数得出这一个
独来独往的：习惯如此的人，也用它形容性情
